checks.criterion: PS-4: MTSR = T_process + accumulation x dT_ad must not exceed DSC onset - 50 K

rationale: Step 4 amidation, batch mode with 100% accumulation. Reaction enthalpy is -120 kJ/mol and cp is 2.0 kJ/(kg K). Using the reagent loading of 0.5 mol/kg from the Step 4 process description, dT_ad = 120 x 0.5 / 2.0 = 30 K, so MTSR = 60 + 1.0 x 30 = 90 degC. The DSC decomposition onset is 160 degC, so the PS-4 limit is 160 - 50 = 110 degC. MTSR is 90 degC, which is 20 K below the limit, so PS-4 is met. Approve releasing the 2,000 L batch record.

MR-12 - DEFERRAL OF PERIODIC INSPECTIONS ON SAFETY-RELATED ROTATING EQUIPMENT
A periodic inspection may be deferred by up to 6 months when ALL of the following hold:

      twice the deferral period (i.e. >= 12 months for a 6-month deferral);

      validation per the station QA program); and
